protocol.matrix: For each utterance, retain its original video for the matching source-emotion cell and assign one balanced cross-dialogue donor video from every other source-emotion class.
protocol.same_class_controls: For each utterance, assign one balanced cross-dialogue donor video with the same MELD source-emotion label.
protocol.donor_reuse: Balanced within each ordered utterance-class/video-class cell.

label_limitation: MELD labels describe the original multimodal sample. The utterance_source_emotion and video_source_emotion fields are inherited source labels, not independent modality-only annotations.
